retrievalProfile.description: A studio portrait featuring an artist in an oversized textured blazer against a neutral mottled backdrop with symbolic props like white tulips and a black cat.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a male artist seated on a stone pedestal, wearing a salt-and-pepper textured oversized blazer and black trousers. The scene is set against a warm-toned, mottled grey-brown backdrop. Scattered white tulips lie on the floor and are held by a partially visible figure on the right. A black cat stands between the subject's legs. The composition is anchored by heavy, bold sans-serif text in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered on a stone pedestal against a textured backdrop
Bold white display text contrasting with dark upper background
White tulips providing a bright organic counterpoint to dark clothing
Partial figure on the right framing the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central seated figure occupies the middle and lower thirds; large-scale typography occupies the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white name text in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold white name, moves down through the song titles, follows the subject's gaze to the cat and tulips on the floor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space around the subject provided by the expansive mottled backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (grey, brown, tan) in the backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black in the trousers, cat, and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white in the primary name text and tulips.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white text/flowers and the dark clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones, black, and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic contrast using the same typeface family in different weights and colors (white vs black).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, bold presence of the main title.
Provides the necessary grotesque sans-serif feel with tight spacing.
Captures the clean, professional 80s editorial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in an 80s oversized grey textured blazer and black pants, seated on a stone pedestal against a mottled tan and grey backdrop. Include white tulips on the floor and a black cat near his feet. Leave the top left quadrant clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in large, bold, white condensed sans-serif uppercase text in the top left. Below it, add song titles in smaller, extra-bold black condensed sans-serif uppercase text, left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the main text white and the subtext black?
Is the blazer oversized and heavily textured?
Are the tulips white and scattered on the floor?
Is the backdrop mottled and neutral-toned?

adjustableVariables: Amount of tulips on the floor
mustRedesign: Avoid exact transcription of existing album titles
Ensure the partial figure on the right is generic

mustAchieve: Balanced distribution of white accents (text and flowers)

postGenerationChecks: Check for condensed sans-serif font accuracy
Verify mottled backdrop has painterly quality
Ensure the black cat is clearly visible against the dark pants
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Mottled Backdrop + [Oversized 80s Fashion] + [Symbolic Prop: White Tulips] + [Bold Condensed Sans-Serif Typography]
